description: IPC access for the .app's live document, which the HealthGate navigates to the bundled sidecar's http origin (Plan B, one origin for SPA + API). A capability applies to LOCAL app URLs only unless it declares `remote.urls`, so without this file Tauri never exposes `__TAURI_INTERNALS__` on that origin: `isTauri()` goes false and every native feature silently dies — that is what made the native menu bar unclickable while Rust's on_menu_event still fired. Deliberately a SEPARATE capability from main-capability so the shell sidecar permissions (`shell:allow-execute` / `shell:allow-spawn`, both with `args: true`) stay LOCAL-ONLY: this origin also serves game/preview content through /preview, and same-origin iframes can reach the top document's IPC via `parent`, which would otherwise hand generated game code arbitrary command execution.
